newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Hutchison Telecom signs CDMA roaming pacts.
newsitem.headline: HK's Hutchison Telecom signs CDMA roaming pacts.

text.p: Hutchison Telecom said on Friday it had signed CDMA (code division multiple access) roaming agreements with two Canadian and two U.S. firms and will provide Automatic Roaming Service in four North American cities. In a statement, Hutchison said it had recently signed the agreements with Canada's BC Tel and Bell Mobility as well as AirTouch Cellular and Bell Atlantic Nynex of the United States. It gave no details of the agreements.
Hutchsion also said it would provide Automatic Roaming Service in the Canadian cities of Vancouver, Toronto and Montreal and the U.S. city of Seattle.
Subscribers in Hong Kong could keep their existing mobile phone numbers when travelling to the four cities, it said.
The company, part of the Hutchison Whampoa conglomerate, also has a majority interest in British mobile phone operator Orange Plc through its Hutchison Telecom (UK) Ltd unit.
